subject: Post-demo: vendor setup, PO vs card, and e-invoice requirements
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@finerahealth.com>, Liza Gomez <liza.gomez@finerahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: vendor setup, PO vs card, and e-invoice requirements

Hi Alex / Liza — great to meet earlier today. Short recap and a few asks so we can keep procurement moving: 

Summary from our call:
- Finera is a good fit for the pilot (clinical notes routing + retrieval) and wants a 3-month proof-of-value.
- Primary constraints for procurement: vendor onboarding timeline, whether AP requires a PO (preferred) or allows card for first-month, and VAT/billing formatting requirements.

Concrete asks / next steps for procurement team: 
1) Who is the PO/vendor-master owner at Finera (name & email) and typical SLA to issue a PO after vendor registration?
2) Confirm whether Finera requires vendor registration before a PO is issued, and if so please share the vendor registration form or portal link.
3) Billing specifics we need to confirm: billing address to appear on invoices, VAT/tax ID for Finera (if applicable), whether invoices must include a PO number and a specific invoice reference format.
4) Preferred invoice delivery format: PDF by email vs. e-invoice (UBL/PEPPOL/XML) or SFTP delivery.
5) Net terms — do you expect Net 30/Net 45? Any credit checks or finance approval steps we should anticipate?
6) Marketplace interest — does Finera prefer procurement via AWS Marketplace / Azure Marketplace (would speed procurement and simplify invoicing) or direct vendor relationship?

I attached our standard Order Form + SOW and a blank vendor registration PDF for you to share internally. If it helps, Marissa (CC) can draft an example invoice that matches your preferred layout.

Proposed internal timeline: vendor form + tax info by EOD Friday 10/30, PO within 5–10 business days after registration. Happy to be flexible — tell us what works.

Thanks — Priyom

Priyom Das

Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: vendor setup, PO vs card, and e-invoice requirements

Hi Priyom — thanks for the clear recap and the attachments. A couple of clarifications from Finera procurement / AP: 

1) Vendor onboarding: yes, our procurement team requires vendor registration before we create a supplier record and issue a PO. I'll attach the vendor registration we use internally. The vendor master owner is Liza Gomez (cc'd) — she manages supplier onboarding. Typical timeframe is 3–7 business days once we have a completed registration and required tax forms.

2) PO vs card: Our default is to issue a PO for any multi-month commitment. For a first-month pilot, we occasionally allow a company card for faster start, but that requires approval from our finance manager and is not guaranteed. If you can accept a provisional PO that references the final PO later, that's helpful, but we prefer a standard PO.

3) Billing details: Please send invoices to ap@finerahealth.com. Invoice must include:
   - Company name: Finera Health, Inc.
   - Billing address: 420 Northlake Ave, Suite 700, Boston, MA 02110
   - Our VAT/Tax ID: US EIN 13-9876543 (use in the tax section)
   - PO number (required) — we will provide a PO once supplier registration is complete.

4) Formats: AP accepts PDF invoices via email; we also support an electronic invoice feed (UBL/XML) over SFTP for recurring invoices. If you have an e-invoicing mapping sheet, send it and our ops team will confirm compatibility.

5) Net terms: Standard is Net 30 after invoice receipt. Occasionally Net 45 is approved for new vendors with trade references; finance will advise after the registration is complete.

6) Marketplace: We have procurement teams that use AWS Marketplace but for enterprise integrations they usually prefer direct vendor contracts (explicit SOW and data handling terms). If you are in AWS Marketplace it can speed purchase orders for smaller teams, but for the pilot we will likely go direct so we can specify data security appendices.

Attaching the vendor registration form (PDF). Once you return the completed form and Redwood's W-9 (or equivalent), I'll route it for supplier creation. Let me know if Marissa needs any specific invoice template to validate.

Best,
Alex
---
Alex Rivera

Appreciate the quick response, Alex — that helps a lot. Next actions from our side: 
- We completed and attached the vendor registration and included our W-9 and company tax info in the form.
- Marissa (cc) will produce a sample invoice that mirrors the fields you listed (billing address, EIN, PO reference, line-item tax breakdown) and will include both a PDF sample and a UBL/XML export example for your ops team to validate.
- On the card vs PO question: we can accept a card for month 1 if you can confirm approval from finance; otherwise we will plan for PO-based billing.

One additional note on marketplace: Redwood is currently onboarding to AWS Marketplace pilot program, but we are not yet published in Finera's private catalog. If you want, we can include marketplace enrollment as an option in parallel — but we agree direct contracting + supplier onboarding is likely the fastest path for the pilot.

I attached the completed vendor form and our Order Form + SOW with the pilot scope. Please let us know the PO owner and an estimated date for PO issuance once the supplier is created.

Thanks — Priyom
